segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company formed to pursue a business combination with one or more target businesses, with no operating revenues.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has determined that the Company only has one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company has no operating revenue; its funding comes from its initial public offering and private placement of warrants.
revenueModel.evidence: We have generated no operating revenues to date, and we do not expect that we will generate operating revenues until we consummate our initial Business Combination.
